questions.stem: A 78-year-old man presents with exertional dyspnea. Shortness of breath has been occurring for several months. It is slowly getting worse . He now feels chest pain and light-headed on exertion as well. O/E- Respiratory rate: 12 breaths/minute; BP: 108/72 mm Hg; Pulse: 64 beats/minute; Past medical history-Hypertension, Hyperlipidemia. Cardiovascular: systolic murmur, crescendo-decrescendo heard best in the second right intercostal area. What is the cause of these clinical findings
